segments.text: In this town, every baby is born with a number floating above their head.
It shows exactly how many lives they will save. Most people get a zero. A firefighter might get a hundred.
But one day, a boy named Leo was born with a number so big, it barely fit above his head. One million.
The whole town went crazy. Everyone said he would become the greatest doctor in history.
But there was one problem. Leo fainted at the sight of blood, and he failed every single science test.
His teacher even told the whole class that his number must be broken.
So Leo gave up. He locked himself in his room and played video games every night, and slowly, the town forgot about him.
Twenty years later, a mysterious virus spread through the town. The hospitals were full, and no scientist could find a cure.
The answer was hidden inside one giant puzzle. But solving it would take them a hundred years.
Then one night, a strange new game appeared online. Millions of people started playing it, without knowing what they were really solving.
Three days later, the scientists received a message. The puzzle was solved. And the game was made by Leo.
And above his head, for the very first time, the number started going down.
